name: Streaming Self Regulation And Securities Markets 07875Bd35D
text: Self-Regulation and Securities Markets states that exchanges have a liquidity-based incentive to regulate insider trading and manipulation. This supplies a traditional-market incentive mechanism relevant to Kaal's identification of market-integrity risks on decentralized exchanges. It does not establish that decentralized exchanges possess or effectively exercise the same self-regulatory incentive.
